title: Asymptotic Separability of Diffusion and Jump Components in High-Frequency CIR and CKLS Models
summary: This paper develops a robust parametric framework for jump detection in discretely observed CKLS-type jump-diffusion processes with high-frequency asymptotics, based on the minimum density power divergence estimator (MDPDE). The methodology exploits the intrinsic asymptotic scale separation between diffusion increments, which decay at rate $\sqrt{Δ_n}$, and jump increments, which remain of non-vanishing stochastic magnitude.
